lists.title: Lists
lists.subtitle: Your own collections of games – across all libraries.
lists.emptyText: Lists collect games across your libraries: a wishlist, games you'd like to borrow, your favourites or an all-time top 10. You can share each list with a link.
lists.noEntriesText: Open a game in your library and use "Add to list".
lists.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? The games themselves stay in your libraries.
lists.publicLinkOff: Only you can see this list. Turn on the public link to share it with anyone – no login needed.
lists.publicLinkOn: Anyone with this link can see the list (read-only).
lists.generalHint: Name and description are shown on the public page, too.
lists.publicLinkHint: Share the list read-only with anyone – no login needed.
